info.description: Photomask RCWA solves, geometry and field views. Lengths in nm, angles in degrees.

schema.title: Response List Presets Api Presets Get

post.description:
Parse a saved project file: fill defaults and upgrade older versions.

The UI sends every opened file through here, so it never has to know the defaults
or the version history itself.

Validate a project and describe the slices the solver would receive.

Domain problems (unknown materials, CD larger than the pitch, ...) come back as
`errors`, not as an HTTP error, so the editor can show them while the user types.

Material map of an x-z or y-z cross-section.

NPZ: `material` (uint8, n_z x n_lateral, index into project.materials), `lateral_nm`, `z_nm`.

Material map of one slice seen from above.

NPZ: `material` (uint8, n x n; rows follow y), `x_nm`, `y_nm`.
Boxes tiling the stack down to z_max_nm (default: the whole stack) for the 3D view.

Complex permittivity on a cross-section (Fourier-truncated in patterned slices if `fourier`).

NPZ: `eps` (complex64, n_z x n_lateral), `lateral_nm`, `z_nm`.

Complex permittivity of one slice seen from above.

NPZ: `eps` (complex64, n x n; rows follow y), `x_nm`, `y_nm`.

The slice's convolution (Toeplitz) matrix [eps].

NPZ: `matrix` (complex64, Nh x Nh), `mx`, `my` (int16 harmonic indices of rows/columns).

post.description:
Start a sweep; records also arrive live as `sweep-records` events on /api/events.

Every point is validated up front (a harmonics sweep must respect the same limits as a run).

delete.description: Cancel a queued or running sweep; forget a finished one.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api Jobs Get

get.description: Status of a run or sweep by id.

SSE stream. Event types:

- `snapshot`: {jobs: JobInfo[]} once on connect (resync after reconnects)
- `job`: {job: JobInfo} on every status change and at most 10x/s while running
- `sweep-records`: {job_id, records: SweepRecord[]} after each sweep value
